_source: Mongoose Traveller 2e Core Rulebook Update 2022, printed pp26-27 (pdf 19-20)
name: Citizen
blurb: Individuals serving in a corporation, bureaucracy or industry, or who are making a new life on an untamed planet.
basic_training_exception: Use the ASSIGNMENT skill table for basic training, not Service Skills.

assignments.name: Corporate
assignments.desc: You are an executive or manager in a large corporation.

assignments.name: Worker
assignments.desc: You are a blue collar worker on an industrial world.

assignments.name: Colonist
assignments.desc: You are building a new life on a recently settled world that still needs taming.

skill_tables._advanced_education_note: Citizen's Advanced Education table requires EDU 10+, NOT the usual 8+.

mishaps.text: Severely injured (as a result of 2 on the Injury table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
You are harassed and your life ruined by a criminal gang. Gain the gang as an Enemy.
Hard times caused by a lack of interstellar trade cost you your job. Lose one SOC.

Your business is investigated by the planetary authorities (or your colony suffers offworld interference). Co-operate and the business or colony is shut down but you gain DM+2 to the qualification roll for your next career. Refuse and gain an Ally.
A revolution, attack or other unusual event throws your life into chaos, forcing you to leave the planet. Roll Streetwise 8+; on success increase any skill you have by one level.
Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.text: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table, but you are not ejected from this career.

Political upheaval strikes your homeworld and you are caught up in the revolution. Gain either Advocate 1, Persuade 1, Explosives 1 or Streetwise 1, then roll whichever skill you chose 8+. On success you come out on the winning side and gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll. On failure you suffer DM-2 to your next Survival roll.
You spend time maintaining and using heavy vehicles, as part of your job or as a hobby. Increase Mechanic, Drive, Electronics, Flyer or Engineer by one level.
Your business expands, your corporation grows or the colony thrives. Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.
You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 10+ to gain any one skill of your choice at level 1.
Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.

You learn something you should not have -- a corporate secret or political scandal -- which you can profit from illegally. If you do, gain DM+1 to a Benefit roll from this career and gain Streetwise 1, Deception 1 or a criminal Contact. If you refuse, you gain nothing.
You are rewarded for your diligence or cunning. Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.
You gain experience in a technical field as a computer operator or surveyor. Increase Electronics or Engineer by one level.
You befriend a superior in the corporation or the colony. Gain an Ally. Either gain Diplomat 1 or DM+4 to your next advancement roll thanks to their aid.
You rise to a position of power in your colony or corporation. You are automatically promoted.
